performanceLimit: averageSampleMicroseconds averages an exponentially smoothed per-call Stopwatch measurement in the Editor. Update, root sweep, and follower sweep call the marker separately. This is not total frame time, a controlled ON/OFF benchmark, or a Quest measurement.
